target.name: whole_molecule_lipophilicity
target.metric: Dev RMSE in original label units at the best-Dev checkpoint

data.official_valid_labels: never loaded; every Valid label stays NaN

candidate.support: every rooted connected induced subgraph of size 1..4 inside R2(root), root in slot 0, all real internal bonds

granularities.FULL: 9 OGB atom columns / 3 OGB bond columns

candidate.dedupe: identical Fit root-level count columns; representative preference: smaller Fit document frequency, then COARSE, then canonical key ascending; all equivalent members recorded
candidate.note: COARSE is an explicit attribute abstraction, not a claim of full chemical identity

x0.normalization: Fit part of each inner fold only

folds.rule: Bemis-Murcko scaffold groups; sorted scaffold keys -> default_rng(seed).permutation -> greedy whole-group assignment to the currently smallest fold (ties by fold index)

selection.standardization: training part mean/std; constant columns recorded, never filled arbitrarily
selection.correlation: Pearson; undefined for zero residual variance
selection.direction_consistency: all three fold correlations strictly same sign

frequency_control.sort: Fit document frequency descending, canonical key ascending
frequency_control.bucket_rule: eligible candidates sorted by (df ascending, canonical key ascending) and split into four contiguous equal-count empirical quartile buckets
frequency_control.match: exact joint distribution over (word size, granularity, df quartile bucket)

positive_control.planted_word_rule: qualified size-3/4 candidate with strictly positive conditional residual variance in all three inner folds, maximising the minimum fold variance; chosen without reading real labels
positive_control.label: y_syn = Fit-standardised x_planted; same Fit scaler applied to Dev

neural.design: shared non-iterative root-level readout, no GNN, no pretraining, no teacher, no distillation
neural.root_input: root atom embedding + sum over real first-order neighbours of a shared pair encoder([neighbour atom embedding, incident bond embedding])
neural.word_input: z_v[t] = log1p(c(v,t)) for the frozen selected vocabulary; BASE uses an all-zero z with the same shape
neural.readout: per-molecule sum/mean/std of the 96-d root representation + log1p(n_atoms) + Fit-standardised 8 graph scalars -> 297 -> 192 -> 96 -> 1
prohibitions: no neural path reading unselected word types

recipe.checkpoint_selection: best Dev RMSE, earliest epoch on ties
recipe.init: deterministic per-seed uniform linear / normal(0,0.1) embeddings; final readout layer normal(0,1e-3)

run_matrix.stage_2_condition: D_TASK beats D_FREQ by >= 0.015 RMSE on D0/s0, or D_TASK beats BASE by >= 0.03 and is within 0.025 of R2_REF D0/s0 0.547679
run_matrix.stage_3_condition: both D0 seeds show a positive TASK-vs-FREQ difference and their mean is >= 0.01 RMSE

references.note: descriptive performance coordinates only; no architecture attribution

bootstrap.comparison: same-molecule paired D_TASK vs D_FREQ RMSE/MAE difference, 95% percentile interval

evaluation.structure_content: top 20 real words by frozen selection score with rooted graph serialization and actual molecular occurrences

verdict_rule.VOCABULARY_PROMISING: task-vs-frequency gain direction-consistent on both D0 seeds and D1; D0 mean gain >= 0.01; both D0 and D1 task models within 0.025 RMSE of their R2_REF
verdict_rule.DISCOVERY_ONLY: task vocabulary better than frequency vocabulary but does not retain strong R2 performance
verdict_rule.COMPRESSION_ONLY: compact vocabulary close to R2 performance but task selection does not beat frequency selection
verdict_rule.NO_SUPPORTED_DISCOVERY: none of the above signals observed
verdict_rule.INSUFFICIENT_OR_INVALID: support insufficient, positive control failed, or implementation inconsistent
